payload.title: Run bounded live ChatGPT subscription transcription experiment
payload.description: User explicitly authorizes a live transcription experiment using their existing OpenCut OpenAI connection. Use a short synthetic speech fixture, fixed official /backend-api/transcribe destination, account-scoped existing OAuth, bounded response and duration. Never expose or copy credentials to browser/output. Record HTTP status, transcript accuracy and returned timing fields; clean up temporary diagnostic route. This tests service access, not monthly billing guarantees or production integration.
acceptance: Perform one bounded live transcription request using the existing authenticated OpenCut session and synthetic speech.
Report observed HTTP result, returned transcript and timing fields without secrets; do not infer billing accounting from HTTP success.
Remove temporary diagnostic route after test and retain sanitized evidence.
